watchlist_definition: degree-ranked candidate-network drugs; fixed before patient-data analysis

NHANES_2015_2018.primary_denominator_note: All observed co-taken pairs formed from DrugBank-mapped medications; candidate-network node membership is not required for both endpoints and candidate-edge membership is not required.

MIMIC_IV_demo_v2_2.role: secondary inpatient prescription-order transport/sensitivity analysis; intentionally small public demo
MIMIC_IV_demo_v2_2.primary_denominator_note: Temporal-overlap pairs are restricted to pairs whose two drugs occur in the candidate-network drug universe; the observed pair itself need not be a candidate-network edge.

ONC_patient_realization.interpretation: Global ONC realization rates differ strongly, but the watchlist-specific ONC contrast among realized pairs is underpowered/non-significant and is not claimed as replicated.

interpretation: The primary patient-transport test uses cohort-specific observed-pair denominators with a frozen watchlist and a cohort-specific random equal-size drug-set null. NHANES includes all observed DrugBank-mapped co-taken pairs; MIMIC-IV Demo restricts temporal-overlap pairs to those whose two drugs are in the candidate-network drug universe. The observed pair itself need not be a candidate-network edge in either cohort. Candidate-edge coverage is secondary operational reach because the top-decile watchlist already covers 65.0% of all candidate-network edges before cohort data are introduced. Neither analysis establishes confirmed interaction status, clinical severity, patient-specific risk, fired alerts, or clinical outcomes.
